# Jeevan Rekha Foods (AB Udyog Pvt. Ltd.)

> Premium Edible Oil Manufacturer from Burdwan, West Bengal, India. 40+ Years of Rice Bran Industry Legacy.

Jeevan Rekha is a leading edible oil brand manufactured and refined by AB Udyog Pvt. Ltd. at its state-of-the-art oil extraction and physical refining plant in Burdwan, West Bengal. Products are NABL-accredited, FSSAI-compliant, and distributed across Eastern India and nationwide e-commerce platforms.

## Core Products

- **Physically Refined Rice Bran Oil**: High smoke point (232°C / 450°F), 12,000+ PPM natural Gamma Oryzanol, rich in SQUALENE and Vitamin E. Ideal for high-heat Indian cooking, deep frying, and cholesterol management.
- **Kacchi Ghani Mustard Oil**: Traditional cold-pressed from premium black mustard seeds, high natural pungency (allyl isothiocyanate), rich in Omega-3 and Omega-6.
- **Refined Soybean Oil**: Light, non-sticky, multi-purpose cooking oil high in Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFA) and essential fatty acids.

## Key Technical Specifications & Health Benefits

- **Refining Method**: Physical Refining (no chemical neutralization using caustic soda), preserving natural bio-active compounds.
- **Gamma Oryzanol**: 12,000 PPM minimum in Rice Bran Oil to support HDL cholesterol balance and heart health.
- **Smoke Point**: 232°C (450°F) for Rice Bran Oil, preventing toxic acrolein formation during deep frying.
- **Certifications**: NABL-Accredited Quality Laboratory, FSSAI Certified.
- **Manufacturer**: AB Udyog Pvt. Ltd., Satgachia, Memari, Burdwan, West Bengal 713146, India.
